Overview.Summary: A React-based internal landing page builder used to create modern, animated, static websites for small business clients. Clients do not edit their sites; they only receive the final deployed website on a custom domain hosted on a shared cPanel environment. All customer interaction flows through WhatsApp only.

Goals.Goal: Create landing pages quickly using reusable components.
Enable drag-and-drop assembly & inline editing of content.
Export final website as a static build (HTML/CSS/JS) ready for cPanel hosting.
Ensure modern UI with animations using React + Tailwind + Framer Motion.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No dynamic backend or server-side rendering.

PrimaryUser.Description: Internal operator responsible for creating, editing, and exporting landing pages for client businesses.

SecondaryUser.Description: Small business owner who will receive a completed website hosted on a custom domain.

Component.name: BuilderApp
Component.TechStack: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
Component.Description: An internal application enabling drag-and-drop layout creation, section editing, configuration saving/loading (via JSON), and exporting final builds.

Component.name: ClientTemplateApp
Component.Description: A generic template project that consumes a JSON config and renders the final client landing page with animations.

Component.name: StaticExporter
Component.Description: Takes a configuration JSON and produces a deployable static build. Outputs /dist folder containing index.html, CSS, JS, and assets.

Component.name: cPanelHosting
Component.Description: Shared hosting used for deploying exported static builds. Each client has a domain mapped to a folder under public_html.

Requirement.Title: Component Library
Requirement.Description: The system must include a reusable library of visual components that can be added to a page layout.

Requirement.Title: Drag and Drop Layout Builder
Requirement.Description: Admin must be able to add sections, reorder them, delete them, and configure content using a drag-and-drop interface.

Features.Feature: Right panel for editing section props

Requirement.Title: Section Configuration Editing
Requirement.Description: Each component must have editable fields such as headings, subheadings, colors, image URLs, menu items, testimonials, etc.

Requirement.Title: WhatsApp Integration
Requirement.Description: All client contact must route through a WhatsApp link using wa.me URLs. A floating WhatsApp button must be present on all pages.

Requirement.Title: Config Save & Load
Requirement.Description: The builder must allow exporting the entire page configuration as JSON and re-importing it later to continue editing.

Requirement.Title: Static Export of Final Website
Requirement.Description: The system must generate a static website build compatible with cPanel hosting. This includes index.html, CSS files, JS bundles, and assets.

Requirement.Title: Animations & Transitions
Requirement.Description: Pages must use smooth, modern animations via Framer Motion or equivalent. Animations should include fade-in, slide-in, hover effects, and scroll reveal.

Requirement.Title: cPanel Deployment
Requirement.Description: Exported builds must be deployable on cPanel as addon domains. Admin manually uploads the /dist files to the client's domain root.

Requirement.Title: Performance
Requirement.Description: Pages must load under 2 seconds on 4G mobile networks. Image optimization and lightweight animations are required.

Requirement.Title: Usability
Requirement.Description: The builder interface must be intuitive for internal admin use with clean visual organization.

Requirement.Title: Reliability
Requirement.Description: Static builds must work offline and without any backend dependency.

Requirement.Title: Maintainability
Requirement.Description: Component library should support adding new components without breaking existing exported sites.

UserFlow.Step: Admin drags sections to create a page layout.
Admin edits content on each section (text, images, colors).
Admin tests animations and responsiveness in preview.
Admin injects config JSON into Client Template app.
Admin runs static build creating /dist folder.
Admin uploads /dist files to cPanel under client’s addon domain.
Client receives domain and final website.

Risk.Description: Increasing number of configs may require organization or version control.
Risk.Mitigation: Use naming conventions and Git repo storage.

Risk.Description: Too many animations may degrade performance on low-end devices.
Risk.Mitigation: Limit heavy animations; use Framer Motion efficiently.

Risk.Description: Manual deployment might become time-consuming as client volume grows.
Risk.Mitigation: Automate build + upload via simple scripts in future versions.
